findings.title: L2 rejects L1b's own read-only transaction command
findings.description: D4: L2 records any GET-time statement not classified READ; the classifier calls SET UNKNOWN; L1b emits SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY before every GET-time read. With the flag on, every GET test, and the L1b proof itself, would fail.
findings.suggested_action: Exempt L1b's own command from L2 without reclassifying SET in general.

findings.title: Comment lexing is underspecified at a security boundary
findings.description: D4 classification contract: the classifier strips comments before keyword classification, but the plan does not specify nested comments, comment markers inside string literals, or `--` without a following space, so two implementations could classify the same statement differently at the GET write lock.
findings.suggested_action: Specify the comment grammar the classifier implements, or stop depending on it.

plan_corrections.fix: Move R10 back before R11 so the sequence reads R9, R10, R11, R12.
